featured_reviews.name: Hamza Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
DANGER !!! SCAMMERS !!!! STRONGLY CAUTION ANYONE CONSIDERING BUYING FROM THIS BUILDER TO THINK TWICE !!

!!!!!THEY DON'T EVEN DESERVE A SINGLE STAR!!!!

I’m sharing my experience to caution potential buyers about this builder.

It has been over 5 years 4 months , and I still have not received any clear communication or confirmed update regarding possession of my flat. Despite repeated attempts to contact their team, calls are often unanswered, switched off, or disconnected. Even during office visits, I’ve only been given vague assurances with no concrete timelines.

At the time of booking, possession was verbally promised for December 2023. However, during registration, I discovered that the RERA possession date was actually December 2024 — a critical detail that was never disclosed earlier.

By that point, I had already paid the booking amount, 10% of the flat cost with taxes, completed home loan formalities, and eventually paid 90% of the flat cost by March 2024. Despite this, I have been paying substantial EMIs for over 4 years without receiving possession.

There has been a repeated pattern of shifting commitments:
• Assured possession by December 2024
• Then promised September 2025 (also confirmed via email)
• Later, RERA possession extended to December 2025
• Yet, possession is still not delivered

A major concern is also the behaviour of their customer representatives, specifically Ms. PREEETI PANDEY and Mr. RAJENDRA MUSTALA. During my interactions, they were extremely rude and unprofessional. I was subjected to abusive language and threatened me by saying " JAA JO KARNA HAI KARLE". which is completely unacceptable.

Despite sending multiple emails and follow-ups requesting written updates, I have received no response. During one office visit, no representative was available, and on another, I was made to wait for nearly an hour. In a particularly disturbing incident, a bodyguard intimidated me by approaching aggressively and taking me to a closed room on the first floor instead of addressing my concerns transparently.

This ongoing lack of communication, repeated delays, misleading commitments, and intimidating behaviour have caused significant financial and mental distress.

I strongly advise potential buyers to exercise extreme caution, verify all RERA details independently, and avoid relying on verbal promises.

I STRONGLY CAUTION ANYONE CONSIDERING BUYING FROM THIS BUILDER TO THINK TWICE

featured_reviews.name: Hamza Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Experience with Paradigm Realty— Highly Disappointing and Untrustworthy

I booked a flat in Paradigm Antalya 102 Downtown back in 2020. The builder promised possession by December 2023. I paid roughly 90% of the total cost well in advance — yet, more than 2.5 years later, the construction is still incomplete and possession has not been handed over.

During this entire period, I have been paying EMIs on a home loan — in addition to paying rent for living elsewhere. This dual financial burden has been ongoing for years, without any clarity on when I’ll actually get my flat.

What makes matters worse: the CRM-person assigned to my account seems to change every 6–10 months. Every time a new CRM takes over, I am given fresh assurances — “you will get possession within 2–4 months” — but the promises are repeatedly broken. Despite raising complaints, all I get is vague reassurances. There has been no concrete timeline, no progress reports, and no visible result.

In my opinion, this is a very poor show of professionalism from the builder and their team. The behaviour reflects lack of accountability, disregard for customer commitments, and gross mismanagement. I STRONGLY CAUTION ANYONE CONSIDERING BUYING FROM THIS BUILDER TO THINK TWICE — at least DEMAND FIRM, legally binding possession dates and insist on transparency before paying substantial amount.

featured_reviews.name: Abhilasha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review for Rustamjee Seasons, BKC

If you’re planning to rent or buy here, I’d strongly say: think twice.

The building looks great on the surface with every amenity listed—gym, pool, squash, TT, yoga rooms—but in practice, it’s a disappointment . Here’s why:
1.	Rigid and impractical rules:
•	Table tennis and squash are restricted with sudden, unclear rules—you can’t just go and play when you want.
•	Gym timings are extremely rigid. Management insists the gym cannot open early because the trainer isn’t available, but ironically, the trainer often shows up an hour late even after the gym has officially opened. Makes no sense.
2.	Amenities without basics:
•	The pool is there, but essential float boards or safety equipment are missing. It’s incomplete and not child-friendly.
3.	Hidden charges everywhere:
•	Even after paying steep rents, almost everything is chargeable—yoga rooms, certain common spaces, and more. Feels unfair and exploitative considering the rent is already high.

On top of this, the hygiene is terrible (toilets stink worse than public ones), lifts are painfully slow, and the management is neither flexible nor approachable. If you’re a tenant, your say is practically zero. Even flat owners don’t have much control since the committee runs on its own agenda. And yes parking is scary-no space to even get into the car-forget your car even being cleaned . I think the list is never ending!

Yes, it’s one of the few residential complexes in BKC, but amenities you can’t use and management you can’t reason with cancel out any advantage.

Verdict: Not worth the rent, not worth the stress. Big no from my side.
